thread:
Avery: Hey team — I just got scheduled for the 11pm-7am rotation next month. The lactation room card reader locks at 10pm. Who do I contact to get after-hours access? I usually need two 20min pumps during the night.

Sam (manager): Quick ping to @people-ops — we should sort this before the schedule goes live. Happy to approve coverage if needed.

Priya (People Ops): Hi @Avery @Sam, we can do a temporary accommodation. Two options: (A) temporary badge access rule for specified windows, (B) paid shift swap coverage. If you want the badge, please complete the short form: https://redwood.company/hr/accommodation and include the expected windows. We'll fast-track.

Avery: Filling now. Preferred windows: 12:30-12:50am and 3:30-3:50am. Badge is preferred to avoid waking teammates.

Devon (Facilities): Badge override is feasible. We'll need building+floor and exact days. We can create a time-bound schedule rule like `lactation_access_avery` for 60 days. cc @security-bot for escort policy after midnight if requested.

security-bot: Security notice: Escorts available after 1:00am upon request. To request, DM @security with ticket ID.

Priya (People Ops): Noted. Avery, if you'd rather keep this confidential, we only record minimal info in the accommodation log and restrict visibility to People Ops, your manager, and Facilities. Also reminder lactation rooms are reserved for pumping; please follow the posted guidelines.

Sam (manager): Team volunteered to cover a 15min rotisserie if badge ends up delayed. We can handle short swaps.

Avery: Thanks all — submitted the form and DM'd Devon with building info. Prefer privacy.

Devon (Facilities): Received DM. Setting up `lactation_access_avery` rule now. ETA 28h. Will post ticket update.

Priya (People Ops): We'll send confirmation email once the override is active and create the accommodation stub. Reach out if you want payroll to review paid swap options.

Avery: Appreciate it, everyone :) Confidentiality please.

Devon (Facilities): Ticket updated: FAC-3582 — lactation access override scheduled.

Priya (People Ops): Closing loop — override scheduled, note in portal. If anything changes with shift times, update the form and we'll adjust. Thanks!
